info.desc: Interactive chat feature for resume creation assistant

chat_feature.folder_structure: /features/chat ├── components/ # Chat UI components │ ├── ChatWindow.tsx # Main chat container │ ├── ChatMessage.tsx # Individual message component │ ├── ChatInput.tsx # Message input component │ └── index.ts # Component exports ├── hooks/ # Custom hooks for chat logic │ └── useChat.ts # Main chat hook with state management ├── services/ # API services │ └── chatApi.ts # Chat API with mock implementation ├── types/ # TypeScript interfaces │ └── chat.ts # Chat message and API types └── pages/ # Chat pages └── MainDialogPage.tsx # Main dialog page with progress bar

component.name: MainDialogPage
component.desc: Main page with progress bar, full-height chat window and vertically centered resume preview with next button

component.name: ChatWindow
component.desc: Chat container with messages and input that uses full available height

component.name: ChatMessage
component.desc: Individual message display with avatar and loading states

component.name: ChatInput
component.desc: Message input field with send button

feature.name: message_sending
feature.desc: Send user messages and receive AI responses
feature.flow: 1. User types message in ChatInput 2. Message appears immediately in chat 3. Placeholder assistant message shows with loading animation 4. API call is made to chatApi (mock implementation) 5. Assistant response replaces placeholder message

feature.name: loading_states
feature.states: - Loading spinner in assistant messages - Disabled input during processing - "Thinking..." text during API call

feature.name: mock_api
feature.implementation: - Random response selection from predefined messages - Simulated network delay (1-3 seconds) - Error handling for failed requests
